verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile explicitly markets PR review, Copilot code review, and code diff viewing on the go, but hands-on community reports concretely contradict smooth review UX: Android diff lines wrap due to large font, per-commit review is hard to use, and the mobile website's diff view is called 'unusable'; there's also no push notification when assigned as a reviewer. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that full diff review works well across platforms, and evidence the reviewer-assignment notification gap has been fixed.
